FamilyMembership.globalWalletExplanation: Each person has one combined coin balance across all their families. Coins and history are retained when leaving a family. Managers see assigned members' combined balance without access to other families' private activity.

FamilyMembership.rejoinImpact: Rejoining will retain the same history and preferences. Archived items and previous manager assignments will not be restored automatically.
FamilyMembership.inviteDescription: Invite a new or existing account to this family. The offered role and manager are fixed to this invitation. Existing account holders sign in with the invited email and explicitly accept; their credentials stay unchanged.
